events.title: Odoacer deposes Romulus Augustulus, the last Western emperor
events.description: The Germanic commander Odoacer deposed the boy emperor Romulus Augustulus and sent the imperial regalia to Constantinople. The date is conventionally taken as the end of the Western Roman Empire.
events.html: The Germanic commander Odoacer deposed the boy emperor Romulus Augustulus and sent the imperial regalia to Constantinople. The date is conventionally taken as the end of the Western Roman Empire.

events.title: Li Shimin takes the Tang throne as Emperor Taizong
events.description: Li Shimin, who had encouraged his father Li Yuan's rebellion against the Sui, took the throne as the second Tang emperor, known after his death as Taizong. He defeated the Eastern Turkic Khaganate and extended Tang power into Central Asia.
events.html: Li Shimin, who had encouraged his father Li Yuan's rebellion against the Sui, took the throne as the second Tang emperor, known after his death as Taizong. He defeated the Eastern Turkic Khaganate and extended Tang power into Central Asia.

events.title: A Saxon army destroys a Slavic army at Lenzen
events.description: Near the Linones stronghold of Lenzen, a Saxon army of the Kingdom of Germany under the magnate Bernhard destroyed an army of the Slavic Redarii. The battle marked the failure of Slavic resistance to King Henry the Fowler's expansion to the Elbe.
events.html: Near the Linones stronghold of Lenzen, a Saxon army of the Kingdom of Germany under the magnate Bernhard destroyed an army of the Slavic Redarii. The battle marked the failure of Slavic resistance to King Henry the Fowler's expansion to the Elbe.

events.title: Siena's Ghibellines rout the Florentine Guelphs at Montaperti
events.description: Near Siena, Sienese Ghibellines, Florentine exiles under Farinata degli Uberti and German cavalry sent by King Manfred of Sicily routed the Guelph army of Florence. The Ghibellines then held Florence until after the Angevin victory at Benevento in 1266.

events.title: Castile and Portugal make peace in the Treaty of Alcáçovas
events.description: The Catholic Monarchs and Afonso V of Portugal and his son, Prince John, ended the War of the Castilian Succession. Afonso recognised Isabella I as queen of Castile, which kept the Canary Islands, while Portugal gained hegemony in the Atlantic.

events.title: Spanish settlers found the pueblo of Los Angeles
events.description: Forty-four settlers of mixed Spanish, Native and African ancestry founded a farming town near the Porciúncula River. El Pueblo de la Reina de los Ángeles grew into the second-largest US city.
events.html: Forty-four settlers of mixed Spanish, Native and African ancestry founded a farming town near the Porciúncula River. El Pueblo de la Reina de los Ángeles grew into the second-largest US city.

events.title: George Eastman patents the Kodak roll-film camera
events.description: George Eastman received a patent for his Kodak box camera. Sold pre-loaded with film under the slogan 'You press the button, we do the rest', it made photography a mass pastime.
events.html: George Eastman received a patent for his Kodak box camera. Sold pre-loaded with film under the slogan 'You press the button, we do the rest', it made photography a mass pastime.

events.title: Arkansas National Guard blocks Black students at Little Rock
events.description: Governor Orval Faubus used the National Guard to stop nine Black students entering Little Rock Central High School. Later in the month Eisenhower sent federal troops to enforce desegregation.
events.html: Governor Orval Faubus used the National Guard to stop nine Black students entering Little Rock Central High School. Later in the month Eisenhower sent federal troops to enforce desegregation.

events.title: Larry Page and Sergey Brin incorporate Google
events.description: Two Stanford PhD students incorporated Google, working from a rented garage in Menlo Park. Its search engine became the gateway to the web and the company one of the world's most valuable.
